mapper.select: SELECT * FROM alarm_rule_boolean WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM alarm_rule_boolean WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT alarm_name FROM alarm_rule_boolean WHERE alarm_name LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '_%')
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm_rule_boolean SET alarm_name = #{alarmName}, boolean_value = #{booleanValue}, boolean_severity = #{booleanSeverity}, boolean_message = #{booleanMessage} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.delete: UPDATE alarm_rule_boolean SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
